entities.name: Al-Khadra Mosque
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Al-Khadra Mosque also known as Hizn Sidna Yaq'ub Mosque, is a mosque situated on the lower slopes of Mount Gerizim in the southwestern quarter of the Old City of Nablus in the West Bank of the State of Palestine. The mosque is rectangular in shape, and its minaret is 30 metres (98 ft) tall.
